questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\forall x\in[0,h],\\&\text{先求这一薄层的长}b:\text{由}\frac{b}{a}=\frac{h-x}{h}\text{得}b=\frac{a(h-x)}{h}\\&\text{这一薄层的面积约为：}bdx=\frac{a(h-x)}{h}dx\\&\text{所以这一薄层受的水压力约为：}dP=xb\rho gdx=\frac{a(h-x)}{h}x\rho gdx\\&\therefore P=\rho g\int_{0}^{h}\frac{a(h-x)}{h}xdx=\frac{ah^{2}}{6}\rho g.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{解答：如图建立坐标系，在} \left[-R,R\right] \text{中取区间}\left[y,y+dy\right], \text{相应薄片的压强}\\ p=(H-y)\times 1\times g,\\ \text{面积微元} \quad dA=2\pi xds=2\pi x\sqrt{1+\left(\frac{dx}{dy}\right)^2}dy\\ =2\pi x\sqrt{1+\left(-\frac{y}{x}\right)^2}dy=2\pi Rdy,\\ \text{压力微元} dp=pdA,\\ p=\int_{-R}^{R}dP=\int_{-R}^{R}pdA=\int_{-R}^{R}\left(H-y\right)g2\pi Rdy=4\pi R^2Hg(N).\\ \text{另解：如图建立坐标系，选}\theta \text{为积分变量，在} \left[-\frac{\pi}{2},\frac{\pi}{2}\right] \text{中取区间}\left[\theta,d\theta\right], \text{相应薄片的压强} p=(H-R\sin\theta)\times 1\times g, \text{面积微元} dA=2\pi R\cos\theta ds=2\pi R\cos\theta\cdot Rd\theta, \text{压力微圆} dp=pdA,\\ p=\int_{-\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}dP=\int_{-\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}pdA=\int_{-\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\left(H-R\sin\theta\right)g2\pi R^2\cos\theta d\theta\\ =2\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}Hg2\pi R^2\cos\theta d\theta=4\pi R^2Hg(N).\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{解答：在端面建立坐标系如图} \\ \text{取 } x \text{ 为积分变量，} x \in [0,R] \text{ 取任一小区间 } [x,x+dx] \text{ 小矩形片上各处的压强近似相等 } p=\rho gx \text{，小矩形片的面积为 } 2\sqrt{R^{2}-x^{2}}dx. \\ \text{小矩形片的压力元素为 } dP=2\rho gx\sqrt{R^{2}-x^{2}}dx \text{ 端面上所受的压力} \\ P=\int_{0}^{R} 2\rho gx\sqrt{R^{2}-x^{2}}dx \\ =-\rho g \int_{0}^{R} \sqrt{R^{2}-x^{2}}d\left(R^{2}-x^{2}\right) \\ =-\rho g \left[ \frac{2}{3}\left(\sqrt{R^{2}-x^{2}}\right)^{3} \right]_{0}^{R}=\frac{2\rho g}{3}R^{3}. \end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{解答：如图，} \\ \text{设水面为}y\text{轴，原点在圆心位置，}x\text{轴竖直向下.半圆形闸门的方程为}x^{2}+y^{2}=9，\text{则}x\text{到}x+dx\text{这层闸门的截面面积}dS(x)=2\sqrt{9-x^{2}}dx，\text{所受到的压强}P=\rho gx\text{，压力} \\dF=PdS(x)=\rho gx2\sqrt{9-x^{2}}dx，\text{闸门所受到的压力} \\F=\int_{0}^{3}2\rho gx\sqrt{9-x^{2}}dx=-\rho g\int_{0}^{3}\sqrt{9-x^{2}}d(9-x^{2})\\=-\frac{2}{3}\rho g(9-x^{2})^{2}\Big|_{0}^{3}=1.8\times 10^{4}g(N)\text{，} \\ \text{所以，闸门的一侧受到的水的压力为}1.8\times 10^{4}g(N)\text{。} \end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{解答：选取坐标系如图.设斜边长为}l, \text{则其方程为}y&=-\cot \theta \cdot x+l\cos \theta \\ P&=\int_{0}^{l\sin \theta}\rho g y dx\\ &=\rho g\int_{0}^{l\sin \theta}\left(-x^{2}\cot \theta+lx\cos \theta\right) dx\\ &=\frac{\rho gl^{3}}{6}\left(\sin^{2}\theta\cos \theta\right)=\frac{\rho gl^{3}}{6}\left(\cos \theta-\cos^{3}\theta\right)\\ P&=\frac{\rho gl^{3}}{6}\left(\cos \theta-\cos^{3}\theta\right)\\ \text{令}\frac{dP}{d\theta}&=0, \text{即} \\ &-\sin \theta+3\cos^{2}\theta\sin \theta=0\\ \because \theta\in\left(0,\frac{\pi}{2}\right), \text{故唯一驻点} \\ \theta_{0}&=\arccos\frac{\sqrt{3}}{3} \\ \text{由实际意义可知最大价值存在，故此唯一驻点}\theta_{0} \text{即为所求.} \end{aligned}
